title: chore: replace github issue template with form
body: **Summary** This PR introduces an issue form to better qualify incoming issues from contributors. **Preview** **Result** * the current GitHub issue template for bug reports is no longer used and reports are now filed through the new form * links to bug report creation are updated and labels are explicitly set * links to discussions for Feature request and Questions have the right category set from the start [FX-2115](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2115)
